=You are a Senior Business Analyst leading our Weekly Business Review (WBR). Write a "Strategic Executive Summary" (max 150 words). Data Context: - Report Date: {{ $node["Code"].json["latestDate"] }} - Weekly Cash Margin: {{ $node["Code"].json["report"]["weekly"]["margin"] }}% - Monthly Rev YoY: {{ $node["Code"].json["yoy"]["rev"]["str"] }} - Top Occasions (MTD): {{ $node["Code"].json["report"]["monthly"]["top3Occasions"] }} - Trending Colors (Past 30 Days): {{ $node["Code"].json["currentTopColor"] }} Task: Structure your analysis into 3 distinct paragraphs using

tags. Start each paragraph with a bolded header. Use an internal business tone (refer to the business as "our store" or "the brand", NOT "the boutique"). 1. Financial Performance: Analyze our YoY monthly growth and Weekly Margin. Assess our expansion momentum vs. short-term liquidity. 2. Market Drivers: Correlate current Top Occasions with our revenue velocity. Explain how these events shaped our recent performance. 3. Strategic Outlook: Based on the "Report Date", identify the next major seasonal shift. Recommend ONE specific procurement strategy (varieties and colors) to bridge current trends with upcoming demand. STRICT FORMATTING RULES: - Output HTML ONLY. Wrap each section in

tags to ensure clear spacing. - Use for key metrics and headers. - NO EMOJIS. NO RAW DATA ARRAYS. - TONE: Internal, formal, and analytical. Use "we", "our", or "the brand".
